title: Hood Homes Blog: Brian E Adams - Videos
channel: Hood Homes Blog: Brian E Adams
uploader: Hood Homes Blog: Brian E Adams
description: Fort Hood is a major US Army post located in the Central Texas Hill Country, an hour north of Austin and an hour south-west of Waco. The surrounding communities, Killeen, Harker Heights and Copperas Cove, comprise a large population larger than any city between Austin and Dallas. Fort Hood has some of America's most affordable living, with the middle 80% of single family homes selling between $52,000 and $250,000. While dominated by the military population, the area has begun to diversify economically, with massive transportation projects still underway. No more than three hours from Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, Austin, and the scenic wineries and lakes of Texas's Hill Country - you have everything Texas has to offer. The Fort Hood area is a great place to work and live.
